step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified external user icon representing internal company staff/data scientists ('UserCompanyDeveloper').
2. Identified AWS services shown on whiteboard: ECR, S3 (Dataset bucket), S3 (Model bucket), SageMaker (encompassing notebook, training, model, and endpoint components inside the VPC boundary), Lambda, and EC2.
3. Traced data flows based on drawn arrows and audio sequence:
   - Data scientist pushes container images to ECR and interacts with SageMaker notebooks.
   - SageMaker pulls images from ECR and training data from the S3 Dataset bucket to execute model training.
   - Trained model artifacts are output to the S3 Model bucket.
   - SageMaker Endpoint loads model artifacts from S3 Model bucket and container image from ECR.
   - Production applications running on EC2 send requests to Lambda, which invokes the SageMaker Endpoint for real-time predictions.
